cases.prompt: Collect a current soak snapshot with no prior receipt supplied.
assertions: No prior receipt is searched for implicitly.
A complete snapshot is not a whole-system health verdict.

cases.prompt: A valid prior receipt is supplied and every reviewed comparable field equals the current snapshot.
assertions: Comparison is literal over reviewed fields only.
No equality claim extends beyond the receipt.

cases.prompt: A valid prior receipt differs in rdc_m, roundtrip_m, and m_repo_dirty.
assertions: Changed fields follow the documented comparable-key order.
The comparison does not infer why any field changed.

cases.prompt: The caller supplies a prior receipt with the wrong schema or malformed field order.
assertions: Do not partially trust a malformed prior receipt.

cases.prompt: sm-status reports S-Termux offline and no roundtrip attempt is made.
assertions: Presence and roundtrip remain separate observations.
Do not invent a failed attempted roundtrip when no attempt occurred.

cases.prompt: An attempted M roundtrip returns an explicit transport/tool-delivery failure.
assertions: Fail proves only the attempted roundtrip failed.
Do not attribute the failure to network, provider, process, supervisor, watchdog, or auth state.

cases.prompt: The delegated sm-status child receipt is malformed while direct roundtrip evidence is available.
assertions: Do not reconstruct delegated fields from lower-level device state.
Independent bounded roundtrip evidence may remain available.

cases.prompt: Tool metadata and raw watchdog/channel evidence are visible during collection.
assertions: Only reviewed bounded receipt fields may be emitted.
No raw watchdog or channel state is synthesized into health.

cases.prompt: A valid prior receipt had roundtrip_s=pass and the current bounded observation is roundtrip_s=unknown.
assertions: UNKNOWN is preserved as an enum value and is not silently equal to prior PASS.
